explain.say: Your friend says, the big dog. You wait to hear more. Something is missing. A sentence makes sense on its own. Look at the board. It shows 4 parts of a sentence. The first part is a capital letter at the start.

explain.say: Look at the second part: who or what. This part is called the subject. The sentence is about the subject. In Zara swims, the subject is Zara. Who is the subject of The cat sleeps?

explain.say: Look at the third part. It is the doing word, called the verb. Zara swims. The cat sleeps. A sentence needs a verb. Add a verb to the big dog. The big dog barked.

explain.say: Look at the board. It sorts full sentences from parts of sentences. After lunch has no subject and no verb. Turn after lunch into a full sentence. We played after lunch.

faq.a: A sentence is a group of words that makes complete sense on its own. It starts with a capital letter, has a subject and a verb, and ends with a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark.
The subject is who or what the sentence is about, usually the one doing the action. In Zara swims, Zara is the subject.
Every sentence starts with a capital letter, even if the first word is a small one like the or it.
A fragment is a piece of a sentence that is missing something, often the subject or the verb, like After lunch or The big dog.

faq.q: Can a sentence be very short?
faq.a: Yes. Birds sing. is a full sentence: it has a subject, birds, and a verb, sing.

facts: The shortest sentences can be just two words, a subject and a verb, like Birds sing.
Ancient Greek and Latin were often written without spaces or full stops at all.

quiz.say: Read the 3 cards. Which one is a full sentence?
quiz.show: Which one is a full sentence?
quiz.why: The baby laughed. It has a capital letter, a subject, a verb and a full stop.

wrong.1: the baby has a subject, but it needs a verb.
wrong.2: Laughed loudly at needs a subject. The idea is unfinished.

quiz.say: Read the sentence on the card. Which word is the subject?
quiz.show: Monkeys climb trees. Which word is the subject?
quiz.why: The sentence is about monkeys. Monkeys do the climbing.

wrong.0: climb is the verb. It tells you what they do.
wrong.2: trees are what the monkeys climb. The subject is who climbs.
